purpose: Independent N2N research quality and discovery review; separate from TSC

queue.identity: Lowercase post ID parsed from a valid NeuronsToNirvana Reddit URL; deduplicate alternate slugs, trailing slashes and annotations.
queue.order: ASCII lexicographic ascending post_id (0-9 then a-z); Reddit IDs are base36, not hexadecimal. This is not chronological/numeric ordering.
queue.resume_rule: Recompute sorted IDs from the pinned source; absent records are PENDING. Select smallest PENDING ID. Leave BLOCKED records visible for retry; never count them complete. On an explicit retry, revisit BLOCKED entries first. Reconcile a new source snapshot explicitly, including newly inserted lower IDs; never rely solely on last_id.

completion_definition.scope: Post and its directly relevant cited sources; comments excluded unless explicitly included. Linked-source recursion is bounded and documented.
requirements: Record actual post access and version/retrieval date without committing source bodies or personal data.
Identify claims and distinguish research, interpretation, testimony and creative material.
Examine available primary sources and document methods, limitations, relevant counterevidence and inaccessible material.
Record duplicate-source relationships and candidate topic/Big Question mappings.
Save a review artifact and explicit scope/limitations. Unexamined material central to the assessment means PARTIAL or BLOCKED.
completion_definition.meaning: COMPLETE means complete for documented scope, never proof of claims, rights clearance, or publication approval.

history_note: No prior review is marked COMPLETE without locating its assessment artifact. Earlier discovery, indexing and metadata enrichment are not full analyses.

boundaries.publication: No automatic publication or integration. This draft records workflow state only.

records.next_action: Obtain authorised source access or owner-provided material with sufficient provenance; then examine the post and directly relevant primary sources.

investigation_register.purpose: Track anomalies, discrepancies and potentially important exceptions for bounded follow-up. Flags are not proof of falsehood, scientific significance or rights clearance.
investigation_register.counting: Three overlapping issue groups across five inspected IDs, not fifteen unique posts. The purposive queue-prefix sample does not establish corpus-wide prevalence. No new completed-read or evidence counts.

items.title: Templated metadata with unresolved provenance
items.priority_reason: Source identity must be established before substantive assessment.
items.observation: All five inspected pilot rows have unknown dates, generic attribution, the same catalogue-summary template and the same research-question wording.
items.uncertainty: Standardised curation may explain the repetition; origin and source existence remain unresolved. This is not evidence of fabricated posts.
items.next_action: Trace the pilot rows' introducing commit and any documented input artefact using repository history.
items.resolution_criterion: Record attributable construction provenance or explicit remaining limits; source verification remains a separate requirement.

items.title: Self-referential external-source links
items.priority_reason: The inspected links cannot support primary-study verification.
items.observation: In each of five inspected pilot rows, external_source_url repeats the row's Reddit post URL.
items.uncertainty: The schema may permit post URLs in this field. Missing independent citations in metadata does not prove the original post had no sources.
items.next_action: Check field semantics in repository documentation and seek existing authorised source-link receipts.
items.resolution_criterion: Document intended field semantics and any independently identifiable primary source; retain unknown where unavailable.

items.title: URL variants carrying apparent catalogue-field fragments
items.priority_reason: Could confuse downstream URL handling or duplicate counts.
items.observation: For each inspected ID the semantic index includes a clean-looking URL and two variants with trailing comma-delimited catalogue tokens. Fifteen rows represent five IDs in this inspected sample.
items.uncertainty: Possible parsing or export contamination; the responsible transformation has not been established.
items.next_action: Inspect the URI extraction and semantic-index construction code or commit history; prepare a derived correction only if causally supported, preserving raw history.
items.resolution_criterion: Identify the transformation and verify a minimal correction against affected examples without changing unique-post or evidence counts.
